description: FLOOD: Annual Average kilometers of roads affected in Projected Climate Conditions (GHoA region) is a data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. Annual Average kilometers of roads affected by floods in Projected Climate Conditions. Future climate conditions for the years 2050-2100 are estimated from the output of the EC‐EARTH3‐HR global model (Hazeleger et al., 2012) with RCP 8.5 and grid resolution of 0.5° (~55 km at the Equator). Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. Its tags are HoA Partnership, Regional Risk Profile, Risk. The portal shows 2021-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
